name: Claude Code
architecture_summary: Runs in a terminal/CI loop: reads the codebase, plans, calls tools (read/edit/bash/git), and observes results before deciding the next step, with human review before commits/PRs merge.
description: Anthropic's agentic coding tool for reviewing, editing, and shipping code from the command line or CI.
notes: AI-recalled from general public knowledge as of 2026-08 -- not independently re-verified for this project.

name: GitHub Copilot Workspace
architecture_summary: Given a GitHub issue, generates a natural-language plan and a draft multi-file implementation for the developer to review before merging.
description: GitHub's issue-to-PR planning and scaffolding tool built on Copilot.
notes: AI-recalled from general public knowledge as of 2026-08 -- not independently re-verified for this project.

name: Cursor
architecture_summary: A VS Code-based editor with codebase-aware autocomplete and chat-driven multi-file edits; the developer reviews and accepts each suggested change inline.
description: AI-native code editor for real-time pair programming.
notes: AI-recalled from general public knowledge as of 2026-08 -- not independently re-verified for this project.

name: Cline
architecture_summary: Open-source VS Code extension that plans a change, then pauses for explicit human approval before each file edit or terminal command it wants to run.
description: Open-source autonomous coding agent with per-step human approval gates.
notes: AI-recalled from general public knowledge as of 2026-08 -- not independently re-verified for this project.

name: Aider
architecture_summary: CLI tool that edits local files and commits each change to git as it pair-programs, using git history as the main safety/review mechanism rather than per-step prompts.
description: Git-native terminal pair-programming tool.
notes: AI-recalled from general public knowledge as of 2026-08 -- not independently re-verified for this project.

name: OpenAI Codex CLI
architecture_summary: Runs in a sandboxed terminal, autonomously reading/editing files and executing commands end-to-end on a coding task.
description: OpenAI's terminal-based autonomous coding agent.
notes: AI-recalled from general public knowledge as of 2026-08 -- not independently re-verified for this project. The CLI wrapper is open-sourced; the underlying model is not.

name: Devin
architecture_summary: Given a ticket, plans a multi-step approach, writes and runs code, and iterates against test results with minimal supervision before reporting completion.
description: Marketed as an autonomous AI software engineer.
notes: AI-recalled from general public knowledge as of 2026-08 -- not independently re-verified for this project. Independent verification of consistent end-to-end success is mixed.

name: Claude with computer use
architecture_summary: Takes screenshots of a virtual desktop, decides on a mouse/keyboard action, executes it, and observes the resulting screenshot in a loop.
description: Anthropic's capability for operating a computer GUI directly, for apps with no API.
notes: AI-recalled from general public knowledge as of 2026-08 -- not independently re-verified for this project.

name: OpenAI Operator/ChatGPT agent mode
architecture_summary: Browses the live web autonomously -- clicking, filling forms, and comparing options -- to complete a multi-step task within pre-approved constraints.
description: OpenAI's browser-operating agent for completing tasks like bookings and forms on a user's behalf.
notes: AI-recalled from general public knowledge as of 2026-08 -- not independently re-verified for this project.

name: Google Project Mariner
architecture_summary: Operates within Chrome across multiple tabs to research and complete shopping-style tasks, as an early-stage research preview.
description: Google DeepMind's experimental multi-tab browser agent.
notes: AI-recalled from general public knowledge as of 2026-08 -- not independently re-verified for this project.

name: Manus
architecture_summary: Takes a high-level goal, plans a sequence of sub-tasks across web/file/tool actions, and executes them autonomously toward the goal.
description: General-purpose autonomous task agent that went viral for broad task completion.
notes: AI-recalled from general public knowledge as of 2026-08 -- not independently re-verified for this project.

name: Perplexity
architecture_summary: Routes a question to a live web search, then synthesizes the retrieved sources into a single cited answer in one pass.
description: Cited, real-time question-answering search engine.
notes: AI-recalled from general public knowledge as of 2026-08 -- not independently re-verified for this project.

name: ChatGPT Deep Research
architecture_summary: Autonomously runs many searches and reads sources over several minutes, assembling a long cited report from the accumulated findings.
description: OpenAI's long-form autonomous research-report agent.
notes: AI-recalled from general public knowledge as of 2026-08 -- not independently re-verified for this project.

name: Claude Research mode
architecture_summary: Plans a research approach, dispatches multiple searches in parallel, then synthesizes the results into a single structured, cited answer.
description: Anthropic's structured multi-step research synthesis mode.
notes: AI-recalled from general public knowledge as of 2026-08 -- not independently re-verified for this project.

name: AutoGPT/BabyAGI (legacy)
architecture_summary: Given a goal, recursively generates its own sub-tasks, prioritizes them, and executes them in a loop with minimal human input.
description: Early open-source autonomous goal-decomposition agents, historically important but largely superseded.
notes: AI-recalled from general public knowledge as of 2026-08 -- not independently re-verified for this project. Widely reported to loop or fail on non-trivial tasks.

name: LangChain/LangGraph
architecture_summary: A framework for composing LLM calls into graphs -- chains, conditional routes, and cyclic evaluate-and-retry loops -- rather than a single fixed agent.
description: De facto standard framework for building RAG pipelines and production agent workflows.
notes: AI-recalled from general public knowledge as of 2026-08 -- not independently re-verified for this project.

name: CrewAI
architecture_summary: Organizes multiple role-based agents (e.g. researcher, writer) into a 'crew' that communicates and hands off work to jointly complete a task.
description: Open-source framework for role-based multi-agent collaboration.
notes: AI-recalled from general public knowledge as of 2026-08 -- not independently re-verified for this project.

name: AutoGen
architecture_summary: Orchestrates conversations between multiple specialized agents (and optionally humans), commonly pairing a generator agent with a critic/executor agent.
description: Microsoft Research's framework for multi-agent conversation patterns.
notes: AI-recalled from general public knowledge as of 2026-08 -- not independently re-verified for this project.

name: OpenAI Assistants API/Agents SDK
architecture_summary: Gives an LLM call persistent state and tool-calling ability (file search, code execution, custom functions) that a developer wires into their own product.
description: OpenAI's building block for embedding tool-using assistants into products.
notes: AI-recalled from general public knowledge as of 2026-08 -- not independently re-verified for this project.

name: Claude Agent SDK
architecture_summary: Exposes the same tool-use/file/shell harness that powers Claude Code as an SDK, for developers building custom autonomous agents beyond coding.
description: Anthropic's SDK for building custom production agents on Claude Code's runtime.
notes: AI-recalled from general public knowledge as of 2026-08 -- not independently re-verified for this project.

name: Devin Desktop
architecture_summary: IDE-integrated evolution of Windsurf after Cognition's Dec 2025 acquisition of Codeium/Windsurf, embedding Devin's autonomous planning/editing loop directly into an IDE interface rather than a standalone background agent.
description: Cognition's IDE product formed by merging the acquired Windsurf editor with Devin's autonomous coding agent; renamed from Windsurf in June 2026.
notes: Verified via live web research (2026-09) -- Windsurf was acquired by Cognition in Dec 2025 (after a collapsed OpenAI deal and a separate Google DeepMind licensing/talent deal) and renamed Devin Desktop in Jun 2026. Distinct product from the standalone 'Devin' background agent already in this catalog.

name: Kiro
architecture_summary: Spec-driven agentic IDE: works from structured specifications defining what's being built before generating code, rather than responding turn-by-turn to prompts.
description: AWS's agentic IDE built on 'spec-driven development,' positioned as the successor to Amazon Q Developer.
notes: Verified via live web research (2026-09) -- Amazon Q Developer stopped accepting new signups May 15, 2026 and reaches full end-of-support Apr 2027, with AWS explicitly steering customers to Kiro. Added Kiro rather than Q Developer to keep this catalog reflecting current tooling, not a sunsetting product.

name: Replit Agent
architecture_summary: Autonomous, browser-based coding agent that plans, writes, runs, and iterates on full applications inside Replit's cloud IDE, with checkpoints for user review.
description: Replit's agentic coding product for building and deploying full applications from natural-language prompts inside the browser.
notes: Verified via live web research (2026-09) for current product name/status; specific use-case framing and score are general-knowledge characterization, not independently audited -- same standard as other AI-curated rows in this dataset.

name: Claude in Chrome
architecture_summary: Browser extension that reads page content (text, DOM, screenshots), clicks/types/fills forms, and manages multi-tab workflows; integrated as a full 'Cowork' client sharing sessions/skills with Anthropic's other apps.
description: Anthropic's Chrome extension for autonomous web browsing and task completion, reaching general availability in Aug 2026.
notes: Verified via live web research (2026-09) -- GA Aug 26, 2026 for Max/Team plans. Security researchers have demonstrated real prompt-injection attack chains against it through 2026; Anthropic mitigates with safety classifiers and high-risk-site blocks but still describes browser use as carrying inherent risk.

name: Gemini Deep Research
architecture_summary: Runs many searches across the web plus a user's connected Google Workspace content (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets), synthesizing a long-form cited report; outputs can become Google Docs or podcast-style Audio Overviews.
description: Google's deep-research agent inside the Gemini app, distinct from and directly competing with OpenAI's ChatGPT Deep Research.
notes: Verified via live web research (2026-09). Independent comparisons find it faster and free-tier-available (5 reports/month) with a larger context window (1M+ tokens) but less rigorous/text-only vs. ChatGPT Deep Research's multimodal, more structured output.

name: Elicit
architecture_summary: Semantic search over 138M+ academic papers (Semantic Scholar and others) combined with automated data extraction and a systematic-review workflow that can screen thousands of papers against inclusion criteria.
description: AI research assistant purpose-built for academic literature review and systematic-review evidence synthesis.
notes: Verified via live web research (2026-09) -- described by multiple 2026 reviewers as the de facto default tool for automating systematic review work; May 2026 self-reported benchmark claims 95%+ search recall and 96%+ abstract-screening sensitivity against a 994-review Cochrane benchmark (vendor-reported, not independently re-verified here).

name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
architecture_summary: Low-code agent builder for creating custom Copilot agents with tool/connector integrations, governed within Microsoft 365/Azure tenant boundaries.
description: Microsoft's platform for building and governing custom AI agents across the Microsoft 365/Azure ecosystem.
notes: Verified via live web research (2026-09) -- rated among leading enterprise agent platforms in 2026 comparisons, with particular strength in Microsoft-tenant governance and 365/Azure integration depth.

name: Salesforce Agentforce
architecture_summary: Agent-building platform layered on Salesforce's Data Cloud and Service/Sales Cloud, letting agents autonomously handle customer-facing conversations (support, sales) grounded in a company's CRM data.
description: Salesforce's flagship agentic AI product for customer service and sales workflows, built on its CRM data.
notes: Already referenced as tool_or_platform in this dataset's Salesforce company_case_studies row (internal Agentforce deployment, $100M reported savings) -- added here as a first-class catalog entry rather than only appearing inside a case study.

name: ServiceNow AI Agents
architecture_summary: Agents built on ServiceNow's workflow/ITSM platform, native to its CRM and service-management data model; widely used for customer support and, following the 2025 Moveworks acquisition, IT-support automation (branded 'EmployeeWorks').
description: ServiceNow's native AI agent capability for IT service management and customer support workflows.
notes: Verified via live web research (2026-09) -- ServiceNow acquired the independent IT-support AI startup Moveworks in Mar 2025 ($2.85B) and launched the Moveworks-powered 'Autonomous Workforce'/EmployeeWorks product in Feb 2026, folding it into this platform rather than keeping it as a separate vendor.

name: IBM watsonx Orchestrate
architecture_summary: MCP-native orchestration layer that coordinates agents, tools, and processes across a company's stack (SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, etc.) with an 'Agentic Control Plane' for auditability.
description: IBM's agent-orchestration platform, positioned for large regulated enterprises needing traceability and governance across AI workflows.
notes: Verified via live web research (2026-09) -- 2026 comparisons cite it for industry-leading auditability and cross-platform integration depth (including interoperating with Microsoft Copilot Studio via MCP).

name: Zapier Agents
architecture_summary: Agentic execution built into Zapier's workflow editor across 9,000+ app integrations, with 'AI Guardrails' that scan for prompt injection, PII, and toxic content before acting.
description: Zapier's agent product for always-on automations that need to reach outside a single AI vendor's connector set.
notes: Verified via live web research (2026-09) -- $50/month for 1,500 activities per current pricing; billed on activities, not tasks.

name: Glean
architecture_summary: Enterprise search foundation (indexing connected tools like Gmail, Slack, Salesforce, Drive with an 'Enterprise Graph' of relationships) extended into agents and actions that can act on what the search layer finds.
description: Enterprise search and knowledge-discovery platform that has expanded into building horizontal AI agents on top of a company's own data.
notes: Verified via live web research (2026-09) -- positioned by 2026 reviewers as one of the leading developers of enterprise-grade autonomous agents, distinguished from narrower competitors by breadth of data-source connectors.

name: Writer Agent
architecture_summary: Agents that plan and execute work autonomously (not just chat) across an enterprise's connected tools (Gmail, Slack, Gong, Adobe Experience Manager, Google Drive), triggered by events rather than only prompts, governed by reusable 'Skills.'
description: Writer's enterprise agent platform, extending its generative-AI writing roots into autonomous, event-triggered work execution.
notes: Verified via live web research (2026-09) -- April 2026 added event-based triggers (act on Gmail/Slack/Gong activity without a prompt); explicitly marketed as competing with Microsoft, Salesforce, and Amazon in enterprise agentic AI.

name: UiPath Agentic Automation
architecture_summary: 'Agentic Business Orchestration' control plane (UiPath Maestro + Agent Builder) coordinating AI agents, RPA robots, people, documents, and applications across an end-to-end process.
description: UiPath's evolution from traditional RPA into an orchestration layer spanning AI agents and robots, including on-premises deployment for regulated/public-sector customers.
notes: Verified via live web research (2026-09) -- added on-premises agentic AI for public-sector/regulated customers in May 2026; UiPath reports ~$1.85B ARR across its platform as of 2026.

name: Gemini Enterprise
architecture_summary: Enterprise search plus agent-building platform, integrating with Google Workspace, Salesforce, and ServiceNow via pre-built connectors; the developer/agent-building layer (formerly Vertex AI Agent Builder) was folded in as the 'Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform.'
description: Google Cloud's enterprise AI agent platform, formed by renaming and merging Agentspace with Vertex AI Agent Builder.
notes: Verified via live web research (2026-09) -- Google renamed Agentspace to Gemini Enterprise starting Oct 2025, then consolidated the former Vertex AI Agent Builder developer platform into it at Google Cloud Next in Apr 2026. Using the current name here rather than the retired 'Agentspace' branding.
